# Tools

| name | v | description | side effect | credits | timeout s | agents |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `edit_listing` | 1 | Write or revise ONE listing text slot (title, bullets, description, search_terms). With no base it writes the first version; with a base it applies the instruction to that base. | none | 5 | 60 | amazon_pdp, general |
| `generate_product_image` | 3 | Draw a picture from a prompt and store it as the first Version of an image slot. When the Task is bound to a product with a saved picture, that picture is passed as the reference so the subject is the real product, not an invented one. Later changes use edit_product_image on a base version, not this tool. | write_blob | 20 | 180 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
| `edit_product_image` | 1 | Edit an existing image version. When `region` is set, the prompt includes a pixel `<bbox>`; the stored Version is whatever the image model returns. | write_blob | 15 | 180 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
| `write_file` | 1 | Write one text file as a new Version. HTML, Markdown and CSV/TSV are previewed; other text is download-only. Does not write PDF, images or audio/video. | none | 0 | 10 | general |
| `read_file` | 1 | Read the current text of one file Version. Does not write a new Version. | none | 0 | 10 | canvas, general |
| `web_search` | 1 | Search the public web and return titles, urls and snippets. Does not write a Version. Page text is included only when need_content is true, and is truncated. Not a login-gated or internal crawl. | none | 1 | 70 | general |
| `web_fetch` | 1 | Fetch one public web page and return its title and markdown body. Does not write a Version. Refuses internal hosts, credentials in the URL, and non-http schemes. Body is truncated. | none | 1 | 70 | general |
| `read_canvas` | 2 | Read the current canvas board: theme, screens (with position, frame and modules) and the clickable flow between screens. Does not write a new Version. | none | 0 | 10 | canvas, general |
| `compose_canvas` | 2 | Write the canvas board as a new Version: several screens laid out on a surface, each with modules that have position, size, style and copy, plus the clickable flow between them. Image modules point at an existing image Version; this tool never generates pictures. Text colours and fonts must be theme tokens. | none | 5 | 30 | canvas, general |
| `generate_variants` | 1 | Branch one screen into 2-4 side-by-side variants that share its content. The copies start identical: edit each with compose_canvas, then the user keeps one. Use this when the user wants to explore directions instead of one fix. | none | 2 | 20 | canvas, general |
| `ask_question` | 1 | Ask the user one question before continuing. Use when a missing fact would change what you build (which product, which direction, which module). Do not invent product names in options. | none | 0 | 5 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
| `record_constraint` | 1 | Record a rule that must keep holding for later turns in this Task, or propose a preference about the user. Does not write a Version and does not change the current one: the user confirms a rule before it takes effect. Call this instead of only saying in prose that you will follow a rule. | none | 0 | 5 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
| `list_versions` | 1 | List the versions a slot already has, newest first, with which one is current. Use it before 'go back to an earlier version' or when the user refers to '上一版'. Does not write a Version. | none | 0 | 5 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
| `restore_version` | 1 | Make an earlier version of a slot current again by writing its content as a NEW version. Nothing is deleted and no vendor is called. Use it when the user says to go back to an earlier version. | none | 0 | 10 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
| `inspect_image` | 1 | Measure an image version against the platform main-image rules: long side, white border fraction, subject occupancy. Returns the exact numbers the rule check uses and what would fail. Call it before submitting if the picture must pass; it costs nothing and does not write a Version. | none | 0 | 20 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
| `fix_image` | 1 | Repair a picture WITHOUT a model: crop to the subject, scale it to the required occupancy and place it on a pure-white square. Fixes 'border not white' and 'subject too small', which are two of the three main-image rules. Costs nothing and takes milliseconds. It cannot change what the product looks like; use edit_product_image for that. | write_blob | 0 | 30 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
| `image_variants` | 1 | Draw 2-4 alternative pictures of the same subject so the user can pick a direction. Each picture is stored as a version of the slot, all sharing the same base, and marked as siblings. Use this instead of calling generate_product_image several times when the user asks for options. | write_blob | 15 | 300 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
| `write_todos` | 1 | Show the user the steps you are working through, and update them as you go. Send the whole list each time; it replaces the previous one. Use it for work with three or more steps. Does not write a Version. | none | 0 | 5 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
| `request_upload` | 1 | Ask the user to upload a picture you need (a product photo, a reference). Use it when a picture would change the result and you cannot proceed well without it. Does not write a Version. | none | 0 | 5 | amazon_pdp, image, canvas, general |
